about.title: About Catequese Viva
about.intro: A complete pastoral platform for Christian initiation, connecting dioceses, parishes, catechists, families, and catechumens in an integrated faith journey.
about.mission_text: To facilitate and strengthen the catechetical mission of the Catholic Church, offering modern tools that enable coordinators, catechists, and families to accompany Christian formation with excellence, simplicity, and security.

offers.classes: Class and catechist management — organize classes by stage, catechetical year, and community.
offers.attendance: Attendance tracking — record presence, absences, and justifications with ease.
offers.sacraments: Sacramental accompaniment — configure personalized sacramental journeys.
offers.content: Content library — create, review, and publish meeting plans.
offers.communication: Pastoral communication — send segmented messages to families and catechists.
offers.reports: Reports and indicators — track catechesis health with KPIs.

pricing.subtitle: A member account is free. To organize groups or catechesis: Catechist Plan R$ 9.90/month (or R$ 99/year). Parish from R$ 99/month. Diocese on request. 7-day free trial for paid plans; card now, charge after trial.

faq.q: How can I try the platform before subscribing?
faq.a: You can create a free member account, join groups, and read the Bible and Catechism. To create groups or use Catequese Viva, try 7 days. We ask for a card now and only charge after the trial.
Taking part is free. The Catechist Plan costs R$ 9.90/month (or R$ 99/year) and covers up to 3 pastoral groups, 3 classes, and 150 catechumens — more than enough for your reality.
You start with a 7-day trial. Stripe asks for a card now and only charges after the trial. No lock-in — cancel anytime.
Annual plans have no automatic refund. Cancellation stops renewal, but access continues until the paid period ends. Proportional refunds are evaluated case by case via contato@catechis.app.

The Catechist Plan covers up to 3 groups, 3 classes, and 150 catechumens. If you need a team and more classes, organize as a parish (Parish Plan). If the diocese takes over, talk to sales — the diocese license covers the parishes. Your data and history are preserved.
Yes. We follow LGPD with encryption in transit and at rest. Children's data receives special protection.

faq.q: I still have questions about the plan. How do I reach you?
faq.a: Talk to the sales team on WhatsApp at (11) 93624-4752. We'll answer subscription questions and help you choose a plan.
